caption: The drawing depicts a large ladle positioned diagonally across the page, with its handle extending from the bottom left toward the upper right, where the rounded bowl of the ladle is shown. The entire sketch is rendered in shades of gray on an off-white background, with shadows suggesting the curvature and depth of the ladle. In the upper left corner, there is an inset detail of an oval shield-like shape containing a depiction of an eagle's head and neck with a striped band below it. In the lower right corner, there is a small schematic outline of the same ladle, drawn with a single continuous line. The artist's name, "Karl Joubert," is written in thin capital letters near the bottom right corner of the central drawing. The composition is bordered by a thin rectangular line close to the edges of the paper.
title: Silver Ladle
